about_the_game:
Experience the thrill of flight and the immersion of virtual reality like never before in this cutting-edge helicopter simulator! Take control of the TG66, a highly detailed rescue and marine observation helicopter, and explore vast oceanic environments. Face challenging missions that require precision, focus, and quick decision-making as you carry out sea rescues and study marine wildlife in their natural habitat.

Helicopter Simulator 2025 - Real Flight PC/VR offers 6 unique helicopter setups and a richly crafted ocean world featuring oil rigs, vessels, sea animals, floating platforms, and much more. The level of realism will leave you speechless!

Become a true pilot by learning how to operate every system inside a real helicopter. Step-by-step tutorials will guide you through startup procedures, rescue operations, flare deployment, and more—skills you’ll apply during missions inspired by real-world scenarios.

The TG66 was built to replicate the behavior of an actual helicopter down to the smallest detail. Startup sequences must be followed carefully—missing a step can keep you grounded. But that’s all part of the simulation: practice, improve, and develop your flying abilities to the fullest.

Full VR Cockpit and Unmatched Realism
• All cockpit systems are interactive and respond exactly as they would in a real aircraft. Keep an eye on your RPM and altitude—helicopter flight demands constant attention.
• Fly near the limits of altitude or close to rocky coastlines and feel the aircraft respond. Realistic physics replicate the challenges faced by pilots during sea rescue operations.

Sharpen Your Flying Skills
• Weather – Choose from a range of weather conditions and test your limits in rough storms or low visibility flights.
• Aerodynamics and Environmental Awareness – Flying over open waters and between oil platforms requires a sharp eye and steady control. Perfect for pilots looking to master emergency response in tough scenarios.

Physics-Driven Experience
• Every part of the helicopter responds to real-world physics throughout flight. With VR, you’ll feel truly immersed in the cockpit.
• Variables like wind, speed, altitude, and helicopter pitch will affect your flight. Missions may involve transporting survivors, cargo, or marine equipment using external ropes and hooks. Total control is critical!

Helicopter Simulator 2025 - Real Flight PC/VR: For the most immersive and authentic VR helicopter simulation, your experience begins here!

MAIN FEATURES
• Exceptionally realistic cockpit and helicopter models
• Full interaction with all flight instruments
• Compatible with HOTAS, gamepads, and 1000+ joystick models
• Beginner and advanced control modes to suit all players
• Machine Gun support for military-based missions
• Expansive scenery including oceans, islands, ships, and offshore rigs
• 7 distinct helicopter paint schemes
• 40 immersive missions – Rescue, Spot, Shooting, Scout
• Free flight mode for open exploration and skill development
• Living environments with sea life, moving ships, rescue teams, and platform crews
• Two beautifully crafted scenarios: Ocean and Desert
• Steam Leaderboard support

Developed by a team of aviation lovers committed to delivering the ultimate VR flight simulation experience!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 or 10 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 (AMD FX 8350) or better.
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD equivalent or greater
  • Sound Card: Default
  • VR Support: SteamVR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 6700K equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD equivalent or greater
  • Sound Card: Default
  • VR Support: SteamVR

short_description: Fly the TG66 in ultra-realistic rescue and wildlife missions over the ocean. Experience full VR cockpit, real physics, dynamic weather, and immersive controls. Includes 26 missions, free flight mode, multiple liveries, and support for HOTAS, gamepads, and joysticks.
